description: Answer "what does this cost in total, delivered?" — items, the exact checkout shipping tier, any running promotion and the total in EUR, for any of the 219 destination countries (all 27 EU countries plus Monaco, US, CH, AU, NZ, HK, SG, LI, IL, AE, SA, QA, KW, CA, PR, CL, GB, MX and 174 more countries worldwide; for the US the import duties are included). Pass the same SKU twice for quantity 2. Includes a checkoutUrl. For a country with its own store and currency (US → USD, CH → CHF, AU → AUD, NZ → NZD, HK → HKD, SG → SGD, IL → ILS, AE → AED) the quote also carries `local` (the same amounts in that currency at the fixed shop rate the store charges) and `storeUrl` (that country's store); item URLs then point to the product pages in that store.

skus.description: Product SKUs from search_products; repeat a SKU for quantity
